correctness.rationale: Every nonzero cubic in four F2 variables is included in a 2^20-1 enumeration. Smoothness over the algebraic closure is equivalent to the four quadratic partials forming a parameter regular sequence, detected by rank 56 among degree-five multiples; each ternary plane section is geometrically smooth iff its three derivatives have zero-dimensional affine common zero, detected by rank 15 among degree-four multiples. Fresh independently written C++ enumerated all 322560 smooth cubics, classified their fifteen planes and found the exact t spectrum 0:1708,4:11340,6:68320,7:10080,8:94500,9:60480,10:64512,11:10080,12:1540. New group-generator orbits of the 1708 t=0 forms have sizes 28 and 1680. Both representatives and stabilizer orders match. All conditions are exact finite linear algebra, not finite-extension sampling.
